name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it's not like that! Synn is, um, well... h-he's just a childhood friend!」
Touka-san looked at us with an amused expression, and then,

name: Fuyuka
message: 「If there is ever another event that we might be able to participate in, please don't hesitate to invite us.」
after saying that, she gave a polite bow and walked away.

name: Synn
message: 「Touka-san is the type of person to say stuff like that, huh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, people always joke like that whenever a guy and a girl walk side by side.」

name: Synn
message: 「A j-joke... Is that really all it is?」
